SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE & S. D REGISTRY Section 2, S. D. 7367 H 3 32 Date March 12, 1932）

REPORT
CONFIDENTIAL

Subject (in full) Letter from Mary A. Thorpe re. Whereabouts of Thomas Lewis
Thorpe

Made by and Forwarded by D. I. Ross.

With reference to the attached letter of February 2,
1932, from Mary A. Thorpe seeking information regarding the
present whereabouts of her husband Thomas Lewis Thorpe, I have
to report that this individual entered the service of the
Public Works Department, S.M.C., as a clerical assistant on
July 18, 1928, in which capacity he has worked continuously.
He resides at No. 25 Young Allen Court, a boarding house run
by Mrs. E. Sosichner (Brazilian).

A letter of a similar nature was also received by the
Public Works Department, who brought same to the notice of
T. L. Thorpe with a request that he immediately communicate
with his wife. According to my information, Thorpe has
already written a letter of reconciliation.

（签名）
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处及特别部登记科 第2科，S. D. 7367 H 3 32 日期：1932年3月12日）

报告
机密

事由（全称）：玛丽·A·索普（Mary A. Thorpe）关于托马斯·刘易斯·索普（Thomas Lewis Thorpe）下落之来信

由 D. I. Ross 制作并呈报。

关于附上的玛丽·A·索普于1932年2月2日发出的、寻求其丈夫托马斯·刘易斯·索普目前下落信息的信件，本人谨报告称，此人于1928年7月18日以文书助理身份进入工部局工务处任职，并一直在此职位上连续工作。他现居住于杨艾伦里（Young Allen Court）25号，该处为一家由 E. Sosichner 夫人（巴西人）经营的寄宿公寓。

工务处也收到了一封性质类似的信件，该处已将此事告知 T. L. 索普，并要求他立即与其妻子联系。据本人所知，索普已写了一封和解信。

（签名）
D. I.

特别科科长。

存档
（签名）
1932年3月12日

2-2-32.

To the British Officer in
Command.

Dear Sir.

I wonder if you could give me
any information about my husband,
"Thomas Lewis Thorpe". He has been living
in Shanghai for a few years. But I
cannot get to know his whereabouts.
He lived at 58. Sinza Rd in 1929 &
employed at Shanghai Municipal Council.
If he has joined any Military
Forces, I should esteem it a great
favour, if you would kindly let me
know. Thanking you.
Yours truly
Mary A. Thorpe.

Pass to Commissioner of Police.

英国指挥官。

尊敬的先生：

不知您能否向我提供
有关我丈夫
“托马斯·刘易斯·索普”的任何信息。他在
上海已居住数年。但我
无法得知他的下落。
1929年他住在新闸路58号，受雇于
上海工部局。
如果他加入了任何军事
部队，若您能惠予告知，
我将不胜感激。谢谢。
您真诚的，
玛丽·A·索普。
